# harness_platform_idp_integration_kind_mapping (Resource)

Resource for the mapping of one kind of an IDP integration. Every kind has a mapping, so creating this adopts it; destroying it leaves the mapping as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every kind of an integration has a mapping. This resource manages it; destroying the
# resource leaves the mapping as it is.
resource "harness_platform_idp_integration_kind_mapping" "services" {
  integration_id = harness_platform_idp_integration.servicenow.identifier
  org_id         = "default"
  kind           = "cmdb_ci_service"

  display_name_field = "name"
  idp_kind           = "component"
  idp_type           = "service"

  # ServiceNow source fields are top-level fields of the kind's catalog stream.
  field_mapping {
    source_field = "owned_by"
    target_field = "spec.owner"
  }
  field_mapping {
    source_field = "environment"
    target_field = "metadata.environment"
  }

  # Links records to entities that already exist instead of registering new ones. source_path is a
  # field of the emitted entity data, not of the source record.
  correlation {
    source_path = "metadata.integration_properties.ServiceNow.name"
    target_path = "metadata.identifier"
  }
}

# Custom integrations build entities from the payload with JQ.
resource "harness_platform_idp_integration_kind_mapping" "orders" {
  integration_id = harness_platform_idp_integration.orders.identifier
  kind           = "custom"

  ingestion {
    identifier = ".service.id"
    name       = ".service.name"
    properties = {
      "spec.owner" = ".service.team"
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `integration_id` (String) Identifier of the integration.
- `kind` (String) Kind whose mapping this is.

### Optional

- `correlation` (Block List, Max: 1) Links records to existing entities. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--correlation))
- `display_name_field` (String) Source field used as the entity's name.
- `field_mapping` (Block List) Maps a source field to an entity field. Airbyte types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--field_mapping))
- `idp_kind` (String) Entity kind, e.g. component.
- `idp_type` (String) Entity type, e.g. service.
- `ingestion` (Block List, Max: 1) Custom types: JQ that builds the entity from a payload. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--ingestion))
- `org_id` (String) Organization of the integration.
- `project_id` (String) Project of the integration.
- `unique_identifier_field` (String) Source field that identifies an entity. Can't change on Airbyte types.

### Read-Only

- `emission` (List of Object) How entities are emitted; read-only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--emission))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether the mapping is the type's default.
- `payload_schema` (String) JSON schema of the payload; read-only.
- `revision` (Number) The integration's revision.
- `updated` (Number) Last update time, in milliseconds since the epoch.

<a id="nestedblock--correlation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `correlation`

Required:

- `source_path` (String) Field to match. Airbyte types: a path in the emitted entity data, e.g. metadata.integration_properties.ServiceNow.name; Custom: a payload field.
- `target_path` (String) Entity field to match, e.g. metadata.identifier.

Optional:

- `operator` (String) Match operator; eq when omitted.


<a id="nestedblock--field_mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `field_mapping`

Required:

- `source_field` (String) Source field.
- `target_field` (String) Entity field, e.g. spec.owner.

Required:

- `identifier` (String) JQ for the entity identifier.

Optional:

- `name` (String) JQ for the entity name.
- `properties` (Map of String) JQ per entity property.


<a id="nestedatt--emission"></a>

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the mapping of a kind of an account level integration
terraform import harness_platform_idp_integration_kind_mapping.example <integration_id>/<kind>

# Import the mapping of a kind of an org level integration
terraform import harness_platform_idp_integration_kind_mapping.example <org_id>/<integration_id>/<kind>

# Import the mapping of a kind of a project level integration
terraform import harness_platform_idp_integration_kind_mapping.example <org_id>/<project_id>/<integration_id>/<kind>
```
